definition.entity_of_line: the planting record's text read by the generator's name pattern (ADR-010 E)
definition.entity_of_question: the question's text by the generator's name pattern (the template reading where the pattern finds none; the record's entity field on the files written before row 49, which carry no question text)
definition.bag: Jaccard index of the two byte multisets
definition.aligned: same byte at the same offset of the name, counted
definition.decisive: a tie at the top is not decisive
definition.bins: by the bag score of the nearest other line: under 0.5; 0.5 to under 0.8; 0.8 and above
definition.mark_oracle_tie: the first maximum in retrieval order where the file carries it (rows 49 and later, the passes), the window's slot order on the files before
definition.not_scored: a read whose window holds a pointer without a text in the file is counted apart, never scored at zero

letter: A0 (iii) or the oracle high with the model following it: read the decision apart (R2 of ADR-008 part A)
